newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin, Citicorp, Habitat set Mexico pension fund. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Serfin, Citicorp, Habitat set Mexico pension fund. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]

text.p: Grupo Financiero Serfin, Citicorp's Mexican unit and Chile's AFP Habitat signed Wednesday an agreement to form a Mexican private pension fund (Afore).

Representatives of the three banks told a news conference that Serfin would have 51 percent of the new pension fund, Citicorp would take 40 percent and the remaining nine percent would be held by Chile's Habitat.
Juan Fernandez, the head of the new fund, said the partners would invest at least $70 million into the pension fund.
He expected the fund to spend $5 million to $8 million on computer systems.
(Corrects to show $70 million figure is projected investment)
